Giờ đây trò chuyện riêng WeChat có thể giao tác vụ cho Mika

Can’t receive new messages right now; Mika will retry automatically

Xác nhận cấp quyền trong WeChat
Send text or images in WeChat and Mika gets work done on this phone, then sends text and image results back. No computer or separate server needed.
Quét mã QR để kết nối
Couldn’t start WeChat binding. Check your network and try again.
The QR code expired. Get a new one and scan it.
The change couldn’t be saved. Try again.
Scan in WeChat and confirm authorization. Then open the bot’s private chat and send text or images. This QR code is only for this binding; don’t forward it.
Khi tắt, Mika ngừng đọc tin nhắn mới
Allow WeChat tasks to wake and unlock
Only tasks from your own linked WeChat private chat can try to wake and unlock this phone.

Off by default; rebinding turns it off. First enable “%3$s” in “%1$s › %2$s” and save your lock-screen PIN or password there, if you use one. This switch does not change that permission or use credentials sent through WeChat.

The WeChat task couldn’t wake or unlock the phone. Unlock it manually, or check wake and unlock permission in Mika’s WeChat settings, plus remote unlock permission and saved credentials in Settings › Connect a computer.
Chỉ bạn, trong trò chuyện riêng
Mika will stop receiving new WeChat messages, remove the saved binding from this phone, and revoke permission for WeChat tasks to unlock automatically.
Private text, images and real tasks

Mika has no relay server, but an internet connection is required. Messages still pass through WeChat; cloud models use the existing network settings. Bot credentials are encrypted with Android Keystore and stored only on this phone.
Mika could not receive the images, so this message was not passed to a task. Check the connection and resend up to 8 images, at most 10 MiB each.
